contexts: regional maternity unit, about 5,200 births a year
412 women a year with a hypertensive disorder
reading: Blood pressure peaks after discharge (days 3 to 6) when nobody is measuring, which remote monitoring addresses (c1). Protocol titration turns measurement into control at six weeks (c3). Readmission is the outcome women and the unit care about but is too rare to power (c2). Digital access and language shape who benefits (c4), so the trial's inclusion arrangements are part of the intervention.

nodes.label: Remote monitoring with hub titration
nodes.detail: Readings twice daily for two weeks, then daily.

nodes.label: Blood pressure control at six weeks
nodes.detail: 76 against 61 percent in a small trial (c3).
